title: 3 What manner of Vnion this is of the two natures in Chriſt: and how made.

segments.text:
THE Vnion of the fleſh with the Worde was not made in the Eſſence or nature, or in any eſſentiall property,
but in the perſon of the Word. That this may be the better vnderſtood we muſt obſerue:

1 What is to bee vnited in nature, or into nature.
2 What likewiſe to be vnited in perſon, or into, or vnto one perſon, or according to ſubſiſtence.
